stories.headline: Member of UK armed forces dies in road traffic incident in Ukraine
stories.description: The incident is not the result of hostile action, the BBC understands.

stories.headline: Israel working to eliminate Palestinian presence from West Bank, NGO warns
stories.description: Israeli human rights group B’Tselem details five mechanisms used by Israel to dismantle Palestinian collective life.

stories.headline: Steep rise in young UK nationals detained for smuggling drugs from Asia
stories.description: Hundreds of Britons have been detained in Thailand on suspicion of attempting to smuggle cannabis to the UK.

stories.headline: Westminster coming to an end, say Welsh, Scottish and Northern Irish leaders
stories.description: The leaders of Plaid Cymru, SNP and Sinn Fein say the UK government should prepare for constitutional change.

stories.headline: Why the Houthi advance towards Yemen’s Marib, Taiz matters
stories.description: Marib is home to Yemen’s oil sector. Whoever controls it secures economic gains. Taiz’s location makes it critical.
